title: How To Discover and Release Your Gift To Impact The World
paragraphs: Please note this down. Discover your gift and unleash it to make an impact on the world. Our focus today will be on understanding the principle of self-manifestation. Write that down. Self-manifestation. People aren't looking for you. They are looking for what you have up your sleeve. If you don't show what you have to offer, the world will ignore you. Just because you exist doesn't mean you'll be successful. Just because you're on this planet doesn't mean people will notice you.

You can live a whole life without humanity noticing you. We could bury you in a cemetery and we would never have known of your existence were it not for that headstone. The reason is that most humans on Earth live on it but never reveal themselves. Therefore, the most important goal in your life should be self-discovery. I want to explain what I mean by that. A few principles should be written down. What is the greatest human need? I will give you eight of them. These needs motivate every human being.

The greatest human needs, I will give you eight of them. First, a sense of purpose. Every human being needs to feel that they were born for a reason. The second human need that exists. Every human being needs a sense of worth. We all want to feel valued and we will do anything to achieve that. Sometimes it's stupid stuff, but we want to feel important, and that leads us to number three. Every human being wants to feel important.

No one in this room, or the millions watching this program broadcast around the world, would deny that they want to feel important. That's why people wear strange clothes. Sometimes people cut their hair in strange ways and you wonder why. Some people dye their hair in strange colors, and you wonder why the person does that? The motivation is very deep and related to these needs; these are not just desires. These are needs. The fourth human need is the need to feel important.

If you ignore someone, it's a deep wound. I think everyone in this room felt the sting of being ignored. You are in a room and people pass by you. How do you feel? Someone you know meets you but doesn't talk to you. How do you feel about that? That feeling is a human feeling. Being chosen for a task by everyone except you causes you deep depression because you want to feel what? Of importance. The sixth human need is the need for a sense of meaning. We want to believe that our lives have meaning.

We are not here on this planet just to eat and breathe oxygen and then evaporate into nothingness. We want to believe that there is a context to our lives, that we were born and sent to this planet to do something, and that there is life after that. There must be meaning to all of this, and every human being seeks that feeling of meaning. We try to find it in religion. We try to find it in yoga. We try to find it in meditation. We try to find it in all kinds of scientific explorations.

That's why we go to the planets. We are trying to find out if we are the only ones here. Is there any meaning to this madness we call the universe? The need to feel that your life has meaning. This is the sixth human need. Write these points down because they are your way of dealing with people. Every human being wants to feel a sense of accomplishment. That's why you want to pay your bills. That's why you want to own a car. That's why you want to complete a task.

There is a desire to feel that I have accomplished something. We want to finish things. We want to be proud of ourselves. This is a human need. And lastly, or rather I should say the last two, is our desire to feel personal power. Let everyone say: Power. I have not yet gotten over the fact that I discovered that all humans strive for power. That shocked me. And I am one of them. We need to feel strong. Let me define power for you. Write it down. Power means the ability to control your circumstances.

Every human being wants to feel that they are able to control their circumstances. That's why we feel depressed when circumstances overwhelm us. We feel helpless. When a doctor tells you that he has discovered something in your body that has no cure, how do you feel? You have lost control of your body. When they tell you that your child is abnormal, how do you feel? Incapacity. When they tell you that the company is closing down and your services are being terminated, how do you feel?

You have just lost your strength. How do you feel when someone breaks into your house and you come back to find everything scattered and broken? You feel violated because you had no control over what happened. This desire for power is a very human feeling and a pressing need. And lastly, our need to feel successful. Now, whatever your definition of success is, it's up to you. But we all want to feel that we have succeeded. We hate failure. We hate the feeling that we haven't accomplished anything.

I was speaking to a young lady recently, and in fact, I was in South Africa. She told me that her manager was having problems. The manager was the general manager of this hotel, a huge hotel, and we became friends. As you know, I have been frequenting South Africa for many years, and this man has become like a disciple to me. He read my books, was guided, and is a rich and powerful man who has been running this entire hotel for years. When he came to me, I told him, "I don't want to see you.

I heard you have a problem." He said, "My marriage is falling apart." We talked for about two hours. Then he took me to my room, and followed me all the way to the door, as you know, because he's the manager. He just wanted to be by my side. We entered the room. We sat and talked for another hour. I prayed with him and gave him some advice. As I left the room, this man, with his elegant suit, beautiful tie, and strong masculinity, turned around, grabbed me, and cried like a child. I took him in.

He told me, " You are like a father to me. I don't have a father to talk to about this pain." So I said to him, " Then you are my son. Go ahead and cry." He cried like a child. Do you know what he was saying while he was crying? I failed. You know, when your marriage falls apart, that's how you feel like a failure. Nobody wants to fail. No success can break a man. The need to feel that you have achieved what you have strived for is a human need. Failure to complete your goal. It gives you a feeling of failure.

Therefore, these needs are very important. And I want to ask you about what I call human questions because they are related to these questions that I have taught for years. These needs are linked to these questions. The first question is: Who am I? The second question is: Where did you come from? The third question is: Why am I here? Question 4: What can I do? The fifth question we should constantly ask ourselves is: Where am I going? All these questions haunt every human being.

You, sitting here today watching this program, I know deep down that you are grappling with these questions. Every human being, all seven billion of us, whether we live in a ten-story building or sleep under a bridge on a cardboard box, these are the questions that run through your mind. Who am I? Most of us find it difficult to answer these questions because they are so scary. Ask yourself the first question for a moment. This is silence. Huh? Who am I? I didn't ask you what you do.

I have asked this question to people. Who are you? I am a doctor. No, this, no, this is what you do. Who are you? I am a nurse. No, this is your profession. Who are you? I asked, " What are you doing?" That's a difficult question. To answer this question, you must answer in two words, right? Who are you? What should you answer? I am. Then you have to fill in the blank. I don't think anyone on earth has used the words "I am" more than Jesus Christ. This is a good sign because it means he knew who he was.

I am the road. I am the bread of life. I am water. I am the door. I am the resurrection. I am the good shepherd. He knew who he was. He did not say "I work as a shepherd". Rather, he said, “I am a shepherd.” He did not say "I will make a door," but rather "I will be." Look, it's a different question, not a profession. I don't want to deal with these questions now because I really want to talk to you about how to embody these questions. First, write this quote. You can tweet it to someone now.

Humans do not decide their own future. When I say human beings, I am talking about all of humanity, males and females. We do not decide our future. We decide our habits. Our habits determine our future. What kind of habits do you have? What is your secret habit? What is your public habit? You are shaping your future with that habit. If you don't exercise, for example, and don't do it as a habit, you are shaping your future. If you have a smoking habit, you can predict your future.

If you have a habit of watching television, your future is shaped by that habit. Therefore, the power of habit can control your destiny. Everything in life is a habit. So you have to decide on your habits. For example, I have a habit of reading the Bible every day. That's what I do. It is a habit, not the act of a spiritual giant. I made it a habit. So, if I don't read the Bible, I feel like a deprived addict. You know, I'm experiencing withdrawal symptoms. What a good habit. Prayer should be a habit.

For most people, prayer is an occasional surprise or only happens when things fall apart. Your habits determine your future. Please write this down. Dissatisfaction is the seed of change. The only way to break a habit is to become dissatisfied with it. In other words, you will never change what you tolerate. How many times have you said, "I need to change this "? You know, but you keep doing it. The reason is that you tolerate it. Anything you tolerate will never change.

So, how do you break this state of tolerance? Here's my advice. Write this down. You will never become what you could be until you are angry at what you are now. Anger brings about change. People say that God is love, and sometimes we use that to excuse evil. But the Bible says that God hates some things too. The great King David wrote down seven things that God hates. Solomon wrote 14 of them. What do you hate? You can't love everything. Not everything can be perfect. Not everything can be acceptable.

Your life is determined by what you hate. Can you write that down now? Your hatred determines your future. Do you hate lying or do you tolerate it? Do you hate corruption or do you tolerate it as long as you don't claim to be involved in it? Do you hate him? Anything you don't hate, you allow. And whatever you allow, you will never change. So, how does this relate to your talent? I want to give you an answer. Write this down. Whatever you were created to become, you now possess. This is a divine principle.

What did you say? Whatever you were created to become, you now possess. In other words, everything you were born to do is not in front of you. It's inside you. Because whatever you are destined to become, God has prepared you for it. The Creator never places the future outside of the thing. It is a very important principle. You now carry your destiny within you. Your future is not ahead of you. He is actually locked inside. I will prove that in a minute before we wrap up. In other words, write this down.

You have come to planet Earth and your future is within you. I'll say it this way. God has hidden your future in a place He knew you would not mistake. Based on our culture, we have learned to go and look for our future, or go towards our destiny, or go to look for God’s will for our lives. Have you heard that before? Go and seek God's will. I remember when I was growing up in the Bahamas, I used to attend religious churches and they would always tell us, you know, go and seek God’s will.

So, I went looking for it, as most of you did, and I never found it. Because God’s will is not hidden behind a wall, or behind a corner, or in another country or another street. God's will was in a place I never expected. They never taught me to look there. In fact, God loves you so much that His will is not a mystery. He hid it in a place you knew you couldn't mistake. Let's put it this way. You were sent to Earth to unleash your potential on Earth.

To everyone in this room and the millions watching this program, I have good news for you. You are not wrong. You are not a biological accident. You are not a cultural burden. You came to this land because there is something the land needs that God has hidden inside you. We have been greatly harmed by our culture. We have been greatly harmed by our society.

We have been greatly harmed by our education systems because they have actually been conditioning us to believe that we are only here to look for a job, pay some bills, and die. Am I right? In fact, everything your parents tell you is about a job. And so we are only prepared to get an education in order to get a job and then work in a place we hate for 45 years, then they give us an hour to go home to sit in a rocking chair and watch the rest of our time slip away. This is what they call retirement. Retirement.

That day I was thinking about the word " retirement". Have you ever looked at that word carefully? It means you are tired. So you're tired again. Double the fatigue. I was brought to this planet, sent here by a greater power to deliver something we need. So I have good news for you, write this down. God created everything with gifts. In other words, you are a parcel sent to Earth to deliver a gift to your generation. You owe it to us. You owe me what you carry. Record this note.

Everything in creation was created by a gift. everything. It took me 30 years to say this one sentence. Research, experience, my own life, the study of creation itself. God did not create anything without endowing it with a talent. Secondly, talent is... I will define it for you. Talent is the inherent ability to perform a function that fulfills a need in this universe. What is talent? Talent is an innate, latent ability. Every word here is important. The word " latent" means that no one can give it to you.

I was born with it. Talent is an inherent ability placed in something to perform a function. The talent you possess to perform your job is to meet the needs of something else in this universe. This is extremely important. You did not come to Earth for yourself, and what you carry is not yours. Let everyone say: talent. So, make a note of this. Talent can never be learned. It can only be polished. Therefore, you can go to university, get a PhD, and still be broke. Because education is not a talent.

You can actually go to school and spend a lot of money at various universities and never hone your talent, because you chose the wrong paths. Most of the people in this room, God forbid, went to university and studied the wrong field because their decision to choose a particular field of study was motivated more by economic possibilities than personal fulfillment. Now you have money, but you are depressed because you are not practicing your talent. Talent can never be learned.

Young people, don't go to school to find a talent. Madam, I promise you, you will never find your talent in education. No one can lay hands on you to give you a talent. They can place their hands on you to stimulate her. No prophecy can grant you a talent. The prophecy might only motivate her. It's innate. Please note this point. This is very simple. Talent is the source of value for a created thing. I am glad you are here because if you understand this, you will not follow the herd. Let me repeat that.

Your talent is the source of your value. Your value comes from your talent. So if you never find your talent, you will be of no value to us. Your worth determines what you will gain in life. You are paid for the value you provide to the land. Don't chase money. Discover what gives you value. Everything that gives you value is the source of your wealth. Let me ask you a question. What makes a dentist valuable? Can you tell me? Well, when you have a toothache and it hurts a lot, who do you think about?

Don't think about your wife or husband, or your lover or girlfriend. Don't think about the dog or your boss at work. Who are you thinking about? The dentist. Now, why? Because the dentist had honed a talent that made him a valuable person. They are so important that you would take your sore gums and drive a long way to get to them, and take money out of your pocket to give it to them. You will even lie on your back, open your mouth and say, "Ah." Why? Because the value in that person is very strong.

They make you give up. Not just your money, but your body too. You were not taught this. What I am teaching you now, your parents never taught you. That's why you struggle to pay your electricity and water bills, and try to manage your life, because they have actually taught you not to look for your true worth. Your talent is the source of your value. I must admit, as a child I grew up with Michael Jackson. Some of you knew Michael when he was older. You know Michael Jackson. Do you know Michael?

Michael was about three feet tall. We were watching that little one on television. Some of you seem very pious now. But you remember that boy, he wore wide trousers at the bottom, wide red trousers, a yellow shirt with a pink hat, and an " Afro" hairstyle with a scarf that hung down to the ground. That little boy would take the microphone and attract millions of fans. He never learned that. Once they asked him, and I will never forget that interview. They asked him, "Do you like music?" He replied: "I am music."

Now, look at these two words. I am. Where did he get his money from all his life? From talent. What were people paying money to see? Talent. People were traveling from the Bahamas to Los Angeles, paying money to see Michael Jackson on stage. That's a lot of money. But look, when you become highly valued, you attract money. If you don't find your talent, I guarantee you will die penniless and poor. content.

This session is probably one of the most important sessions of your life, because you are still stuck in the job search. Do you know what's good about talent? You don't have to look for it. I believe the greatest curse that has befallen the human race is what they call "employment". Forgive me, but this is just what I believe. Because employment destroys your talent. It even prevents you from thinking about it.

If you study our culture, all of our cultures, and look at them, you will find that they are based on employment. When you go to school and sit in class in elementary school, the teacher never asks you: "What talent do you think you have?" They never ask you that. In high school. You completed all of high school and they didn't ask you about your talent. They ask you about the profession you want to pursue. Look, your profession is not your talent. You usually choose a profession that promises prosperity.

And so you find yourself well-educated and trained, yet still trying to pay your phone bill. Nervous. Your talent is the source of your value. Please write this down. Your goal determines your talent. This is a very important statement. What did you say? Your goal determines your talent. Now, there is something more important than your talent, and that is your purpose. But it is your goal that produces the talent. If you can find the purpose of something, you will also discover its talent at the same time.

So if you don't know what your goal is yet, I guarantee you don't know your talent. Now I want to bring up a slightly deeper idea here. The power of your talent. Your talent is so powerful that it is mentioned in the Bible. Proverbs 18, verse 16. Can you read it aloud with me? never. Human talent opens the way for him and makes room for him among the great ones. It is not him, but she who makes room for him. Human talent is very powerful. She gives him space. Where is he making room for him? In the world.

What does the word "world" mean? Systems. Listen, the systems want to shut the doors in your face. They tell you how far you can go. They prevent you from getting promoted. They are hindering your progress. They even tell you when you're going to retire. They are blocking your progress. If you don't like someone, you're in trouble. But according to this statement, your talent ignores everyone else. It makes room. Even someone who hates you will look for your talent. How many of you love your dentist?

You don't like that. In fact, you hate the feeling it causes in your mouth, but you still go back to it all the time. Why? Because it's not about the person. Let me ask you a question. You claim to be a Christian, whatever that means, and you have a medical problem. You are suffering from an illness, perhaps a tumor or something like that, and the only person in the hospital who is able to treat you skillfully is a Muslim. Now you are preparing to die. You need to have this thing surgically removed.

You need a professional. I don't need someone who speaks foreign languages ​​now. I don't need any religious texts. You need talent. So that you can make a decision. I don't want a Muslim to touch me. Okay, so there will be a funeral. That 's my point. When it comes to meeting needs, talent is more important than the person himself. So take $200,000 and pay it to this surgeon through your insurance, even if he does n't believe what you believe, because it is your talent that gives you space in the system.

Every day now. every day. Not a day goes by that I don't receive an invitation to speak somewhere about the things I'm good at. Every day, including this morning, they come looking for your talent. They pay you money to provide it to them. They may not like you, but they want what you have. Your talent is so powerful that your enemies come and pay you money for it. So, let me conclude with this. Write this down. The seed's talent lies within the tree. I'm right, aren't I? Yes. Please write down each one of these.

The talent of the seed is the tree. I'm right, aren't I? When you see a seed, it holds a talent. So, the mango seed holds a talent. What is talent? tree. Where is the tree? inside. Look, I'm telling you, the future is not outside of you. Here's another point. What is the tree's talent? Its fruits. A talent is also trapped inside the tree. These are the fruits. It is perhaps important to mention here that trees never eat their own fruit. I told you that your talent was never meant for you.

It is to meet the needs of another person. Mangoes are full of food, vitamins, minerals, and all sorts of ripe and beautiful things to keep you alive. However, the tree does not eat any of it. Your talent is supposed to meet the needs of other people. Let me ask you another question. Why go to a mango tree laden with fruit? I mean, here's the mango tree, with beautiful golden mangoes ready to be picked. What makes you jump over a fence like I used to? Don't tell anyone about it. And she steals mangoes.

Why would you jump over a fence and risk your life in front of a dog? Talent is so powerful that it makes you break through walls. I am speaking to you now. There are people calling me from Australia saying, " Look, you have to come on September 19th and we don't care how much it will cost. We'll send you a plane ticket worth $10,000. We'll pay you $5,000 an hour. Just come here." In other words, we are jumping over the fences. Listen, when you go to a mango tree, you never go there for its bark.

You don't go to the tree for its leaves. You don't go to the tree for its branches. You don't go to admire the carvings on the tree. So why are you going? For one thing, you go in search of the fruits. In other words, people are not supposed to be attracted to you because they may not even like you. But if you show your talent, refine it, hone it, and mature it, I guarantee that they will overcome their pride. Look at one of my sons there, Ilan, sorry, Eduardo. Eduardo owns a health resort. He and his wife.

And you know, my problem is that I can't massage my back. I mean, I know I'm good at many things, but I can't reach down there with my hand to massage my back. So, when I want a massage, I have to swallow my pride and admit that I can't massage my own back. And I go to him and say, "Look, I'm going to lie down. Just tell me how to lie down. And do what you do." His talent lies in his hands. His talent makes him rich. Some of you work for $17 an hour. Some of you work for $5 an hour.

As for him, he works for $160 an hour using only the talent of his hands. Please write this down. What is the talent of tree leaves? Oxygen. Look, everything has talent in it. The seed contains the tree, the tree contains the fruit, and the leaves contain the oxygen. God did not create anything without putting a talent in it. If there were no papers, we would have died. We need tree leaves. That's why they tell us: "Don't cut down trees. Don't destroy the Amazon rainforest.

Don't keep building roads and parking lots, because asphalt doesn't give us oxygen." Do you know that? Just like you. If you leave us, we will have lost a talent. If you die now, you have robbed us. Or if you never find your gift, you are a thief of generations. Your gift is your commitment. By the way, when people discover and enjoy your gift, they will take care of you. Oh my God, you just said something profound. Let me say it again. If your gift benefits someone, they will take care of you.

You said it's like a tree. If the tree is fruitful and gives you fruit, what do you do? You fertilize it. She puts water in it. She trims it. Why? Because you want it to continue producing. So if you give your gift, find what it is, and present it effectively to your generation, they will fund your patronage. Can you imagine people being obligated to keep you alive because you give life? Write this down. Very important. The bird's gift is flight. Notice that birds don't go to school to learn to fly, do they? Yes.

Why? Because giving is an innate trait. The bird is born with the ability to fly. What is the fish's gift? The ability to swim. Swimming. Swimming is an instinctive trait in fish. Fish do not attend swimming lessons. Go and explore the ocean. You never see a fish classroom. She swims in flocks, but she doesn't go to school. Clap. Am I right? Yes. So, whatever your gift is, you were born with it.

Perhaps this session was brought into your life by God just to test you in the middle of the year, because you may have reached the end of your patience where you feel frustrated and feel that you are not making any progress, and perhaps you are fed up with life, and some of you may be thinking about divorce, ending your life, or even suicide, and God says: "Stop." You are loaded with treasures. Glory to God. Do not deprive us of your truth. I will put it this way. A gift from the sun. The sun has a gift.

It emits strong ultraviolet rays. If the sun did not exist, we would all be dead. The sun provides ultraviolet rays for the leaves. The tree absorbs light and produces chlorophyll in its leaves. Chlorophyll releases oxygen that keeps us alive. No sun, no human being. The sun is a gift and she has a gift. So, to sum it up, let's talk about Jesus. Jesus Christ came to Earth with a gift. He said, " The Son of Man did not come to be served." This is an important statement.

The Son of Man did not come to earth to be served. This is found in the Gospel of Matthew, chapter twenty. The Son of Man did not come to earth to become what? Served. You did not come here for us to serve you. He said: I came to offer myself as a ransom. wow. This is enough to cheer for two weeks. Let me quote it to you slowly. He said, "I came to Earth to offer myself as a ransom." This means salvation and redemption for humanity. Let me say it again. I came to introduce myself. You still don't understand.

He said, "Look, you are not practicing salvation. You are He." Mika says: "I don't make music. I am music." Tiger Woods does not play golf. Serena Williams, God have mercy. This woman is crazy. They thought it was over. She came back to defeat everyone and sweep the field. Bam. What? She doesn't play tennis. My question is, who are you? Have you found out who you are yet? Your talent is your reality. Jesus Christ came into the world to give his gift.

That is why it is called the gift of salvation for many who believe. If you leave here and do not eat from the tree of Jesus Christ, you will not receive the nourishment of eternal life. Its fruit is the only fruit that contains the nutrients of eternal life. You may follow Buddha and memorize his sayings. You may follow Hare Krishna and repeat what he says. You may follow Muhammad and you may memorize all the rituals of Islam. You can follow these maharajas, these wonderful maharajas of Hinduism.

Listen, the only one who possesses the nutrients of eternal life, you should applaud him warmly for that. Jesus Christ said, " Come to me and I will give you eternal life." You can try other trees. He said, " You can eat from any tree. It's fine." But he said, "If you want the nutrients to live forever." I just want to read a written text to you. Genesis, Chapter 1. He says: “And God made the earth grow grass and vegetation, and yield seed of its kind.” The tree that bears fruit had its seed in it and within it.

A very important principle. In other words, he sowed everything within himself. So God created everything and planted everything within it. That is why God does not create trees anymore. Because the seed of self is within her. The future is within. When God created you, He placed you in a mold. You came into this world with everything you were meant to become. That is your gift. I love this verse. In 2 Corinthians 9 it says that he who provides the seed, God will never give you trees. What does he provide for?

By sowing. God always gives you something within something else. The child you gave birth to is not really who you think he is. They are carrying something. That's why they call them seeds. My father is here. I love my father. Hello, Dad. My father is 90 years old. I'm sure my father used to listen to us and watch us as we grew up. There were eleven of us, and we were used to crawling on the ground in Baytown, the dirty ground. I'm sure he never thought I was one of those children.

I, this person you see here, could never have imagined that I had a son with 62 books inside him. Tell him there was no way he could have dreamed that his son would be on television being watched by more than 1. 2 billion people from a wooden house. God provides the seed. My father gave me a seed. And in that seed was a talent. I feel good every time I meet you. You know that I meet with you. Every time I meet someone, I feel happy. I say to myself, I wonder what is inside this person.

Tell your neighbor, if you know what's inside me. Go ahead, tell them. I would have bought myself lunch today. I mean, think about it. When my wife married me, I had no money. But my wife somehow had a vision. Glory. Hallelujah. She called it love. It was a vision. She said, "This person seems destined to become something important. I'm going to get involved with him now before someone else takes him from me." You don't even know who you married. You have no idea who your husband will become.

Never judge a person based on their current state. They possess talents. And listen, when the talent manifests itself, you won't be the husband. Do you understand what I'm saying? Lord, have mercy. My wife is the happiest woman in the world. You will not have to work another day in your life if you do not want to, in the name of the mighty Jesus. But she had no idea what was inside me. You are a gift to the world. Don't let anyone judge you. They have no idea how much you are worth. That's why I respect people.

I respect every human being. I don't ignore anyone. I am kind to everyone. Just in case they become billionaires, they should be nice to me. Now applaud. Clap now. You don't know. You have no idea. Tell your neighbor. Shake my hand. Shake my hand. Okay. Get to know me now. Okay. Because when I become great, I want to say that I was your friend, you know. Yes. Remember me. By the way, this is what the thief said to Jesus. Remember me when you come.

Look, in other words, I'm not sure what might happen, but let me call you now. Okay. And I was thinking about one of our priests there. I think about this a lot, you know, Maridge Store. When I first met Marage Store, he was working at a hotel. He was a hotel manager. He came to BFM, sorted out his thoughts, and realized that he had fallen in love with the law. His talent was great. So he left the hotel. People say: You are the manager. Are you going? Yes. I will follow my passion.

He left the hotel, went to London, and obtained his law degree. He now owns a law firm. Now his wife Charlie is very happy that he didn't stay at that hotel. Applaud God for whom? You don't know who is sitting next to you. I would say that your profession may not be your talent.
